# Shaadi Sunnah

> Shaadi Sunnah (shaadisunnah.com, also written ShaadiSunnah; earlier name "Sunnah Safar") is a Muslim matrimony platform for Nikah in India. Profiles are reviewed by the team, the process is family-first (guardian/wali details supported), and mobile/WhatsApp numbers stay private until both sides accept an interest. Photos and full names are blurred for logged-out visitors. A free Biodata Maker is available.

Shaadi Sunnah is a matchmaking/introduction platform. It does not guarantee marriage; families should independently verify details before finalising a rishta.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://shaadisunnah.com/): overview, search, registration, FAQ
- [Free Biodata Maker](https://shaadisunnah.com/biodata.html): create a Nikah biodata
- [Community Guidelines & Safety](https://shaadisunnah.com/safety.html): rules, safety tips, how to report
- [Privacy Policy](https://shaadisunnah.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://shaadisunnah.com/terms.html)
- [Careers](https://shaadisunnah.com/career.html)
